description: Configure Confluence credentials. Two-step flow: (1) call without `spaceKey` to validate the credentials and receive a list of available spaces — relay them to the user. (2) call again with the same `baseUrl`/`email`/`apiToken` plus the chosen `spaceKey` to persist. Credentials are stored in `~/.mason/config.json`. Warn the user that the API token will be visible in chat history before they paste it.

baseUrl.description: Confluence base URL. Accepts `acme`, `acme.atlassian.net`, or `https://acme.atlassian.net` (normalized automatically).

parentPageId.description: Optional parent page ID under which Mason's index page is created

spaceKey.description: Confluence space key. Omit on the first call to list available spaces.

name: mason_set_confluence
